subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: What should the CLI contract be when a same-session Gateway agent dispatch waits behind active work long enough to exceed the lane wait threshold?
rationale: The bug fix is clear, but the user-visible behavior affects operator scripts: stderr text, JSON error shape, and whether lane-busy uses exit code 1 or a distinct temporary-failure code need maintainer intent before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Distinct busy result
options.body: Return a structured `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` result with actionable stderr/JSON and a stable distinct non-1 exit code for automation.

options.title: Message-only compatibility
options.body: Surface an actionable stderr/JSON error but keep exit code 1 to minimize shell-script compatibility risk.

options.title: No terminal busy result
options.body: Reject fail-fast busy behavior and limit the fix to better diagnostics/timeouts, leaving same-session dispatch semantics unchanged.

recommendation.title: Distinct busy result
recommendation.body: Return a structured `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` result with actionable stderr/JSON and a stable distinct non-1 exit code for automation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans CLI operator UX and Gateway agent dispatch semantics, both areas with strong history from this owner.
